Condition node
This node is an if-else node, used for designing branching processes within the workflow.​
When input parameters are fed into this node, it will determine if it meets the conditions under the if section; if so, it executes the corresponding if workflow branch, otherwise, it executes the corresponding else workflow branch.​
Each branch condition supports the addition of multiple judgment conditions (AND/OR), and simultaneously supports adding multiple conditional branches. The priority of the branch conditions can be set by dragging the branch condition configuration panel.​
